notes.title: UPDATE ALPHA 0.15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978575/147a5dfcd835ba10f837b990f6cbb63e0575c159.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]UPDATE  ALPHA 0.15[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]What is new ?[/b][/h2]
- Message info log now appears on player's death, disconnection or reconnection
- You can reconnect on disconection (Still needs improvement,  some buggs for the player who reconnects may occur)
- Life is now displayed in numbers on the UI
- New building meshes for the library are available: the monk is happy!
- Special(F) and trust(R) attacks are not interrupted by hits anymore

[h2][b]What has changed ?[/b][/h2]
- Range units have new names to fit with the bow
- Updated UI with some new props and missing stuff
- Improvement of the collision system (hits are more accurate on low fps host)
- In the arena, weapons are now respawning

[h2][b]Bugs fix[/b][/h2]
- Fixed duplication of resources with the new class
- Clients can't pick up bags while dead
- Fixed friendly fire option
- Fixed hotbar which was full yellow during potion cooldown
- Life regeneration shoudn't happen while dead
- Fixed end game damages to player which was always 536
- Fixed Lifebar not displaying correctly on life upgrade
- The defeated team doesn't see the victory animation anymore

notes.title: UPDATE ALPHA 0.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978575/89e17cb1d1123aabee75a7a059e233cd62be4474.png[/img]

[h1][b]UPDATE  ALPHA 0.14[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]What is new ?[/b][/h2]
- Characters have their own statistics
- Bag is now dropped on death
- You can't run anymore with a bag to prevent easy stealing
- After 30 mins of game the kings goes for a final fight on the bridge
- Various sounds added or edited
- Life regen is now active after a while out of fight for a very small amount of life
- Friendly fire is now an option on game creation

[h2][b]What has changed ?[/b][/h2]
- Stamina system edited (boost)
- End game panel now shows damage deal
- Moving the mouse in the settings doesn't bind anymore

[h2][b]Bugs fix[/b][/h2]
- Fixed pikeman and barbarian friendly fire not applied correctly
- Fixed trap damage on arena
- Fixed the fact that clients can run while blocking
- Fixed end game panel bug with too many players
- Fixed settings UI always resetting to audio

notes.title: Patch note Alpha 0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978575/f88243c400f7aa3bc715ff494f6798704fe4d584.png[/img]

[h1]Here is the new Beodara Patch note![/h1]

[h1]Alpha version 0.3[/h1]

[h2]Bugg Fix[/h2]
- Blocking doesn't use stamina
- Bow should use stamina
- Bow acts like a "submachine gun" 
- Bow shoots are way too strange (sometimes fly in the air)
- Jumping doesn't use stamina
- 2handed weapons missing blocking animation
- Death screen is too fast
- Weapons damage are cumulative when switching weapons

[h2]Edits[/h2]
- Lowered the Camera
- Reduced Aiming and blocking movement

[h2]News[/h2]
- Replay button at end of game
- Thrust attack with 2handed weapons

Enjoy ! :Beer:

notes.title: First ever Patch note!
notes.content:
[h1]Here is the first ever [b]Beodara [/b]Patch note!

[b]Alpha version 0.2[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Bugg Fix[/b][/h3]
- Issue with the mouse disappearing while toggling menus (in game)
- Hosting /finding game has issues sometimes (have to re-launch the game)
- Green side elevator is very dark
- If you roll in traps, blood shouldn't spawn
- Bow can be used while being dead
- Sometimes the weapons are not picked up by the animation

[h3][b]Edits[/b][/h3]
- Reduced the walking movement

[h3][b]News[/b][/h3]
- Name In Game

Enjoy !
